Hi Leah,

Appreciate the fast turnaround and for attaching the notarization receipt. I’m looping in Marcus (billing) and Naomi (tax) to confirm the acceptance criteria.

We generally accept scanned resale certificates accompanied by a signatory verification, but acceptance of a digitally-notarized receipt depends on state-specific rules and our internal evidence checklist. Specific checks we’ll run:
- Certificate contains EIN and legal business name matching our billing record
- Signatory authority is clear (title, corporate role)
- Notary verification URL resolves and shows tamper-evident metadata
- For OR/WA/CA we sometimes require a wet-ink if the notary type isn’t recognized in our nexus state acceptance matrix

We’ll validate and come back with either: (A) release invoices once checks clear; or (B) a short list of missing/incomplete items. Expect an update within 48 business hours.

Two quick questions while we validate:
1) Was the signing done by an authorized officer (title on the PDF)?
2) Do you have a DocuSign/verification link for the notary receipt?

If you prefer, I can open the hold for a partial release while we finish the review — let me know.

Best,
Irene Choi
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
